title: (Gocara-Abhinīhāra)
text: 1-7 Sāvatthi || || Samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo || || Samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo || || Neva samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo || || Samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca || || 9-10 Seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ || khīramhā dadhi || dadimhā navanītaṃ || navanītamhā sappi || sappimhā sappimaṇḍo || tatra aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo ca ayam imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ || pa || uttamo pavaro cāti || ||
